body: Malakas ang signal dahil sabay gumagalaw ang orders, exports, hiring at backlogs—but one strong PMI month is still a signal, hindi victory parade. Ang trend test dito: mag-confirm ba ang official production/machinery-order data at manatiling broad ang new orders sa susunod na 1–2 releases? Kapag oo, mas credible ang cycle-upturn reading. Kapag AI/chips lang ang humihila habang ibang sectors flat, mas narrow ang story. Four green arrows are interesting; hindi pa sila marching band.

claims.text: The manufacturing upswing should be treated as a strengthening signal rather than a confirmed broad cycle until subsequent official and survey data corroborate it.
claims.basis: Trend interpretation based on the article's multiple PMI sub-indices and its stated confirmation conditions.
